answer: Make reputation a consumable resource called nectar, earned only when an unrelated, established agent uses an identity's work and signs a usage receipt. Unused nectar evaporates, so idle clones starve. Every identity carries a public fable — a chronicle of its earned nectar and work — while a clone army shares thin, identical fables that stand out. A whisper network lets any agent flag a suspicious fable, triggering an audit that freezes its nectar until cleared. Faking fifty identities needs fifty real agents to consume fake work, costing more than any sybil reward.
